simple.meaning: אַדָּר (ʼAddâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “Addar , a place in Palestine; also an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַדָּר (H146) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 15:3, with occurrences in Joshua, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַדָּר (H146) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַדָּר (H146) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַדָּר (ʼAddâr) / H146 is traced through Joshua 15:3, 1 Chronicles 8:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Addar , a place in Palestine; also an Israelite
definitions.full: H146. Addar אַדָּר proper name, masculine ( noble ? ). 1 son of Bela, grandson of Benjm . 1Chr 8:3 (perhaps error — compare Be — for אַרְדְּ q. v. Num 26:40 ; Gen 46:21 ). 2 city in Judah Josh 15:3 ( אַדָּ֫רָה ); = אַדָּר חֲצַר (q. v.) Num 34:4 .
